items.description: Surge-damaged speaker system and TV set
items.rationale: Lightning overvoltage covered under 2.3.3, subject to EUR 5,000 aggregate appliance sub-limit; no surge protection established, so indemnity halved. Market replacement for TV + speaker system ~3,000-4,000, halved to ~1,750.

items.description: Diagnostic surge-failure report and technician call-out (3 pcs)
items.rationale: Diagnostic/report is contractor's measuring outlay or assessment, not a repair cost (7.1.8(e)); call-out only indemnifiable alongside indemnifiable work on the same invoice, one per attendance (7.1.8(d)); likely excluded or minimal, halved.
